user.title: Deye Cloud
user.description: Create an application on **developer.deyecloud.com** to get the App ID and App Secret, then enter your **Deye Cloud** account (the one used in the app).

data_description.region: Shown as “DATA CENTER” on developer.deyecloud.com (EMEA = Europe).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Deye Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: Deye Cloud rejects the stored credentials. Please enter them again.

local.title: Local connection (optional)
local.description:
To read the Deye **every 10 seconds** on your network, like Solarman: IP address of the Deye Wi-Fi logger (e.g. 192.168.1.50). Leave empty to use Deye Cloud only.

The logger serial number is found automatically (logger powered) or taken from Deye Cloud; otherwise it is on the logger label.

data.sans_test: Save without testing (inverter off at night)

data_description.sans_test: At night the Deye is off and does not answer: tick to save anyway.

error.invalid_auth: App ID, App Secret, e-mail or password rejected
error.no_stations: No station found on this account
error.cannot_connect_local: The Wi-Fi logger does not answer (IP, port or serial number?). At night, tick “Save without testing”.
error.serial_required: Serial number not found automatically: please enter it (logger label, or Solarman)
